answer: Each identity joins the oasis work pool by locking a 60-credit lotus bond and files one own-key sample each epoch. A willow index compares each sample with all earlier ones; a too-close sample burns the filer's lotus bond, and auditors recheck matches. Costs rise: the first fake's costs 30 credits, the kth 30 plus 2 per earlier fake, so the 1000th pays 60 plus 2028, and 1000 fakes cost 1,089,000 credits. A rented-sample ring fails: a rented sample sits in the willow index under another key, so resubmission matches and burns the bond. An honest agent files its own work once and keeps its bond.
